function.description: Describe a short video with a dedicated omni-modal model and return a factual text description. The video URL is sent to the model, which watches the video itself; no local frame extraction happens and the result is text only. Use this when the primary agent needs a text description of a video. Use view_video instead when the primary model can inspect image frames directly, and model_view_image for still images. Audio is handled by the omni model when it can perceive it.

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL of a short video.

focus.description: Optional aspect to prioritize, such as visible text, product placement, or motion. Omit when the user asks for a general description.

model.description: Optional model override. Do not set unless the user explicitly names a model; omit to use the default.

system_prompt.description: Optional analysis prompt that replaces the built-in default. Do not set unless the user explicitly provides an analysis prompt. Never copy end-user content into this field.

extra_params.description: Optional sampling overrides. Omit unless the user explicitly asks for a different sampling rate or frame budget.

fps.description: Frames sampled per second of video.

min_frames.description: Minimum number of frames to sample. Defaults to 6 when omitted.

max_frames.description: Maximum number of frames to sample. Defaults to 90 when omitted.

total_pixels.description: Total pixel budget across all sampled frames.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the visible answer.

enable_search.description: Enable web search for this call.
